summary: The change adds a single method archive_payments to the payments store layer, moving terminal-status payments to an archive table. The payments table holds no NPI fields, so ENC-1 and RET-1 are unaffected. All SQL statements use parameterized queries, satisfying SEC-1. The releases table is separate from payments, so PAY-2 idempotency is preserved. Process obligations are met: the change ticket is approved with correct components, an independent code_review from a change_approver and a security_review from a security_reviewer both target the head commit, and the CI suite (172 tests) passes cleanly on the final commit including all relevant control tests. No protected paths or control data are touched, and no prior evidence lapses.
